notes.title: V 0.9.0 RELEASE - Network Multiplayer, Track Editor Upgrades, Visual Refreshes
notes.notes:
To celebrate the first anniversary release of Metric Racer into Early Access, we’re closing the chapter on version 0.8 and releasing [b]version 0.9.0[/b]! So what is new, and what is there to look forward to!

[h1]NETWORK MULTIPLAYER[/h1]
Network multiplayer is out now! Race with or against your friends either through multiple Dedicated Servers or locally across LAN. There are 4 sets of dedicated servers:
[list]
[*] Europe
[*] Asia
[*] North America – East
[*] North America – West
[/list]
Single Race and Survival modes are supported along with all Official Metric Racer tracks. More modes and custom track support is coming in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/3819fe6896588d2ad44e5f5957f49a5fde10caeb.png[/img]
List of Dedicated Servers alongside a view of the Lobby

[h1]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
Along with the network support, Version 0.9 comes with a number of visual improvements and re-worked tracks:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/eee142ff1102e0d66f135614cdcc188bb433e8d2.png[/img]
Building glow, particle effects, track themes and imroved
[list]
[*] Improved and re-worked Tracks
[*] Improved Building Glow
[*] Particle Effects
[*] Track Themes
[/list]
[previewyoutube=4bBdKTkG0Ms;full][/previewyoutube] 
[h1]Track Editor Improvements[/h1]
There's been a number of editor improvements, new track entities and track themes to customise your own tracks with. I've also added a tool tips that guide players on the Editor Workflow as well as an option to fill in tracks now. Pressing Ctrl+B while having two end nodes selected will bridge the gap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/a3a50a0e4e6b309c0ee1748c3322db048c778828.png[/img]

A New blocked out track theme has also been added in the track editor to help in creating levels and debugging tracks. This helps give more contrast with a simpler mesh to modify, speeding up track iteration time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/f40a17e2d7b29bc22372089aa35d200f841d5c0b.png[/img]

[h1]Moving Forward[/h1]
The 0.9.X series will be taking the foundation from 0.8.X and polishing and expanding across all of it. Mod support is the next big feature to get out which will add everything from small content updates to full code additions, so stay tuned for that!

This is a passion project, and I'm grateful for everyone who has played Metric over the last year and given feedback! It's still evolving and growing but is getting closer and closer to my vision every day. 

Keep in the loop with everything going on or chat with me over on Discord! Until then, I'll see you all on the track.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XRfTFPk3TM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/b1470ce58b534f348208c1295b4fd0abd2c75b96.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: [v 0.8.5.230] New Years Release! Editor upgrades, Improved Visuals & New Items!
notes.notes:
This year has been big for [b]Metric Racer[/b]! There's been a number of improvements in the experimental stream with improved editor gizmos, improved visuals and new track items in the Sandbox! These improvements were so good that I decided to throw them into the main stream as the last update of 2021!

In the mean time, I'm working away at getting Networked Multiplayer working, so stay tuned for more about that!

Thanks again for playing and providing feedback for Metric! It means the world to me! 

Happy Holidays and a have a very Happy New Year!

notes.title: Metric Racer - Feature Release Roadmap
notes.notes:
Metric Racer has been out for a number of months now and has been getting great feedback on where and how it can improve. 

The game is developed by a [url=https://github.com/rtroe]single person [/url] in their spare time and so feedback on both design and quality is hugely appreciated in making this game as fun as possible.

There are a number of updates planned for the upcoming months and so I wanted to share what that roadmap looks like.


[h1]v0.8.5 - Portals, Tournaments and Achievements[/h1]
This update is almost ready and can be tried out now in the experiemental branch through Steam! Version 0.8.5 brings big gameplay improvements with Tournaments and Achievements, letting you race different playlists comprised of different gamemodes.

[h2]Portals[/h2]

A new mechanic as well, Portals, will be part of 0.8.5 freeing racers to not just be contained in a loop. This has recieved a lot of positive love so far but there are still some performance issues that need to be solved. 

Check out [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/9OY6XtL]this link here of the portals in action[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/9b1cc80dcef5ebfeba841ed108055bbafed45c98.png[/img]

Look for 0.8.5 coming out in [b]mid Novemeber[/b].

[h1]0.8.6 - Online Multiplayer[/h1]

One of the features Metric shipped with was split screen multiplayer, but the requests for online multiplayer are growing louder and louder. In parrallel to the current release, I've been working at getting networked multiplayer working in Metric. There will be a number of jam sessions where I'll be hosting some online races for people to test out the feature and to give feedback on how well they think it might work. 

I'm aiming for these sessions to take place [b]closer to the end of the year 2021[/b], I'll be announcing when those sessions will be happening through [url=https://twitter.com/VirtexEdge]Twitter [/url]and the [url=https://discord.com/invite/XRfTFPk3TM]Virtex Discord[/url], so join and follow there to find out how you can join.


[h1]0.8.7 - Mod Support[/h1]
When of the key features I planned for Metric was mod support. I want to hold off on fully releasing this aspect though until the full 'feature list' is complete. The game has been architected from the ground up with mods in mind though, so soon after Online Multiplayer is released, you can expect Mod Support to be close on its heals. 

Mod support will range from adding in custom racers, all the way to being able to write code and modules that fully extend the game.

A good example of how this was done on another Virtex game was with The Chaotic Workshops Mod SDK which is already [url=https://github.com/VirtexEdgeDesign/chaoticworkshop-modkit]available on GitHub[/url]. The Metric one will be very similar.

[h1]0.9 - Polish and Additional Content[/h1]

The 0.8.X series of updates is centering around features. Once those features have been implemented and proved out I'll be moving on to the 0.9.X versions. These will include further polish and refinement along with additional content, tracks, racers etc. I am aiming for a [b]Feb/March 2022[/b] date for this.

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1]

This is a passion project, and I'm grateful for everyone who has played Metric and given feedback! It's still evolving and growing but is getting closer and closer to my vision every day. These updates will be big ones and so they're taking a little longer, and your paitence is greatly appreciated.

Keep in the loop with everything going on or chat with me over on Discord! Until then, I'll see you all on the track.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/XRfTFPk3TM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/b1470ce58b534f348208c1295b4fd0abd2c75b96.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Track Editor Patch - v 0.8.4.183
notes.notes:
This patch comes with a number of updates and bug fixes for the Track Editor:
• Context menu added. You can access this through LCtrl + Right Mouse Click
• Added Box Select to Track Editor. L Ctrl + Left Click and drag to select entities in bulk.
• Added Track Node refresh button. This will re-connect any disconnected track nodes from editing.
• Fixes a bug where old physics meshes could be duplicated when track nodes are modified, causing racers to randomly fly off.
• Fixes null error when some nodes are deleted.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.4.174
notes.notes:
This patch has a number of bug fixes and stability improvements for the Track Editor
[list]
[*]Added a 'Play' tab to the Editor. This tab will have more settings and options when 0.8.5 comes out later this month such as 'Play Reversed' and 'Test Single Race / Time Trial/ Survival' etc...
[*]Fixed a crash where nodes could become null during multiple undo-redo's.
[*]Fixed a crash where Editor Entities could become null during a Track Editor session.
[*]Fixed a crash where Water size doesn't deserialize properly. Default sizes added as a fallback.
[/list]

[list]

notes.title: V0.8.4 - New Racing Teams, Upcoming Track Editor Jam & Soundtrack Release!
notes.notes:
Keeping with the 4-6 week release cadence, [b]Version 0.8.4[/b] is out now with some pretty large changes to some noticable and not so noticable parts of the game. The bulk of changes and work is mostly under the hood to help support future updates, but there are still a number of visual and performance improvements along with a number of bug fixes.

[h1]Racing Teams and Lore[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/6c81632a3ee83920466e77eee7077953c201d4c7.png[/img]
As you may notice, there's some added visual improvemnts and flow to the Ship Editor. Most ship components are now associated with a Racing Team or Sponsor such as 'Firefly Racing' and 'Skyline Extra Solar Research Group.' These teams are represented with new Holo-Banners available in the Track Editor as well.

Along with this the Ship Hanger has had a substantial UI update and refresh to visually communicate the ship parts stats in a clearer way. There's lore available as well by right clicking on Ship Editor components.

[h1]Track Editor Jam[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/9a32a1c6141d70f3908011222be765de109a499d.png[/img]
Virtex Edge is hosting a Track Editor Jam the weekend of [b]July 23rd-25th[/b] to see what the Metric community can create! Join us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/virtexedgedesign]Twitch [/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/qjvgn5s]Discord[/url] to discuss and share what you come up with! When you're happy with it you can upload it to Steam Workshop to share it with everyone!

In lead up to the event, a [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYZJghLeoNQ-stjovYpvVsw]HOW TO Tutorial video[/url] will be coming out on the Virtex Edge Youtube channel walking through all of the different features in the Sandbox Track Editor, so give the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYZJghLeoNQ-stjovYpvVsw]Virtex Channel a subscribe [/url]to stay in the loop!

[h1]Soundtrack[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/ba7ea3f4faf452c17dc2432f7e5bef20e4a828e2.png[/img]
A collection of tracks from Metric Racer are being released as a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1664560/]standalone soundtrack through Steam[/url]. 

As a thank you to all those who tested out Metric Racer during the beta check your inbox for a steam key for access to the soundtrack when it releases soon!

[h1]Engine Overhaul[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/a25e530eba389cdee71ef8e410bcd5f80406bf09.png[/img]
A complete overhaul of the rendering system, an upgrade to Monogame 3.8 and a full migration of the game from .Net Framework to .Net Core has given way to a huge number of changes and reworks under the hood of Metric Racer. 

These updates have resulted in loading times upwards of 3 times faster then 0.8.3, a new standalone binary in Linux (not requireing mono any longer), along with better visuals through out the game. This should also solve a number of rendering issues that some players have been encountering.

[h1]Upcoming 0.8.5 Release[/h1]
I'm aiming for a late July early August release of 0.8.5 which will finally bring out Tournaments and 'The Rocks' region. You can always try out the latest and greatest in the Experimental Branch of Metric Racer. Join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/qjvgn5s]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/VirtexEdge]Twitter[/url]! to stay in the loop of what's the latest.

notes.title: V0.8.3 Update - Improved Visuals, Faster Loading Times, Editor & Gameplay tweaks
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.3 is out now with Improved Visuals, 50% Faster Loading Times, and a number of Editor & Gameplay tweaks!

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/6643b5253dce083de040aa9d251cd8dc527e4870.png[/img]
Skyboxes now have selectable cube maps for each planet and level theme along with improved Crepuscular Rays, fog and sun rendering. This is the first pass at a larger rendering rework which will be fully rolled out in the next couple releases.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UNDsBuHsTwI

[h1]Loading Times[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/5954c4ae722d3c98eaff3cacba5bad2ec4a4e2a4.png[/img]
One of the main comments about Metric is it's long loading times. This update improves the loading times by upwards of 50%. This can be further improved though and v0.8.4 currently has a full rework of the content loading system and track generation which has improved loading times from 90 seconds in worst cases down to 25 seconds.

[h1]Cloud Saves[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/c8fa10ac0d027f9eb48261ac9afcbb40b3dc0e65.png[/img]
Are you playing on different machines, or cross platform on both Linux and Windows? Cloud Saves are now enabled which will sync your settings and sandbox files across all machines that you play Metric Racer through!

[h1]New Editor Items[/h1]
There are some new editor items in the sandbox for you to try out! As the larger bugs in the early access version of Metric are sorted out I will be shifting my focus more to content to help spur on the creativity!

[h1]Cannon Firing[/h1]
Cannon firing now only happens when the mouse or trigger button is pressed, instead of emptying the entire clip after one click.


But as always I'm always open to suggestions through [url=https://discord.com/invite/qjvgn5s]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/VirtexEdge]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: V 0.8.2 Update - Global Leaderboards, Nightly Builds & Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.2 is out now! Global Leaderboards, Nightly Builds and a number of bug fixes have gone into this one! 

[h1]Leaderboards[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/5fe7a9b7d6d67a5aa013222f51ca4c356ceab947.png[/img]

Now you can show off your best time for all to see. [url=https://metricracer.com/leaderboards.html]Global Leaderboards[/url] are now available for each race type and difficulty setting!  At the end of each race your best lap time is shown compared to all those who've flown before you so you can see where you stack up against the competition!

The entire list of top times are shown online as well, head on over to the revamped [url=https://metricracer.com/leaderboards.html]metricracer.com[/url] to check out the [url=https://metricracer.com/leaderboards.html]leaderboards page today[/url]!

If you don't want to have your times saved it's as easy as turning the setting off in the new Profile dialog under 'Settings > Profile' from the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/5c32c9020655f08d1bb69a3cc05a36afe3af8034.png[/img]


[h1]Experimental Builds[/h1]
Don't want to wait until v0.8.3 tp try out the next set of changes?! [url=https://metricracer.com/nightlybuilds.html]Experimental Builds[/url] of Metric Racer of the the latest and greatest are now available. The build pipeline will spit out and upload a fresh build with the [url=https://metricracer.com/experimental.html]latest changes[/url] each night and upload the changes to the website. If you like what you see or have some feedback, let me know through [url=https://discord.com/invite/qjvgn5s]Discord[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/aa6b27148aee6456bcecda1618657bb4df5da1a5.png[/img]

You can[url=https://imgur.com/a/pQywkFZ] opt in and out through Steam[/url] at any time by going to [b][i]Metric Racer > Properties > Betas [/i][/b]and select the '[b]Experimental[/b]' channel in the drop down. The change list is also [url=https://metricracer.com/nightlybuilds.html]posted on our website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/MetricRacer]tweeted [/url]out every night when ever there's new changes along with the new build so you can see whats new and available! This is my development stream though, so don't be surprised if you encounter a few more bugs.

[h1]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h1]
One of the major bugs was racers getting stuck in the rocks when racing. I've reworked how the collision is handled with those elements which should drastically improve the reliability of those collisions. Some other bug fixes include:

[list]
[*] Player Profile screen has been added which gives the player a view of their progress and control over their profile setting.
[*] Player stats are now saved in a separate file for better handling
[*] Fixes Workshop Levels Defaulting Back To Previously Played Levels When Exiting
[*] Fixes Bug With Description Text Not Working Properly In Menu Slider
[*] Fixes Busan Level Not Opening under certain circumstances
[*] Fine tuning of difficulty settings
[*] Tuning of AI and Player relative acceleration rates
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Features[/h1]
Some upcoming features for Metric are:
[list]
[*] Improved Skyboxes with more content and visuals
[*] Improved Cannons
[*] Improved Item unlock sequence
[*] Tournaments fully added
[*] The Rocks Region
[/list]

But as always I'm always open to suggestions through [url=https://discord.com/invite/qjvgn5s]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/VirtexEdge]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: V0.8.1 Update - Difficulty Settings, Import/Export Custom Models
notes.notes:
Version 0.8.1 is out now! With it comes a series of updates, changes and bug fixes!

[h1]Difficulty Settings[/h1]
A major comment with Metric is that there's only been 1 difficulty up until now, That changes today with the addition of the Alpha, Beta and Gamma leagues. Alpha is substantially easier than the current difficulty and the perfect spot for new players, Beta is slightly easier than the current state of the game, and Gamma is a step above all else for those who want to be the best!

[h1]Import / Export Custom Models[/h1]
The sandbox now includes the ability to import your own custom models. This lets you bring in anything you can make in Blender or Maya into Metric. Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2421961374]new guide over here[/url] that layouts out how to get your custom creations into Metric!

[h1]Physics and Controls[/h1]
Another major item of feedback has been that the ships respond too rigidly and that the physics is too tight. 0.8.1 has heavily re-worked the ship drifting and physics for each difficulty setting, along with adding in Air brakes and side slip, letting players handle their drifts and corners with better control!

notes.title: Version 0.7.5a Released - Track Width, Screen Shake dampened, Sandbox Updates!
notes.notes:
[b]Version 0.7.5[/b] has been released which adds a number of requested changes and bug fixes. 

[h2]Track Width[/h2]
One of the big updates is the default track width has been increased to allow for better flow when racing. Each of the nodes control the local width which allows players to tighten or loosen the track as needed.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/d2680f15dabc6f6f1814cc70c2e719c2b5fdb0e5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/d2680f15dabc6f6f1814cc70c2e719c2b5fdb0e5.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Screen Shake Glitch Effect[/h2]
The screen shake glitch effect has been pulled back substantially, a cooldown has been added and the distortion has been pulled back as well. In addition there is a graphics setting now to disable it entirely if needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37655107/8cd76dddf0c1d2a2b2def7e2fdeb216189410f99.png[/img]

[h2]General Level Cleanup[/h2]
Each of the currently released levels had a cleanup pass as well. The track width has been tuned and the AI pathing has been tweaked as well.

[h1]Full Change Log[/h1]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Track default width has been increased, Track Nodes can now change and modify track width
[*] Impact Screen shake effect dialed down substantially
[*] Option to disable Screen shake effect added in Graphics Settings
[*] Improved AI Node editing
[*] Luna track mesh variations updated
[*] General Level Polish
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes bug where not all track parts would extrude properly
[*] Fixes bug where cliff physics meshes would persist in sandbox after delete
[*] Fixes bug where players would get stuck upside down in NewNewYork
[*] Fixes missing Luna starting line track mesh 
[*] Improved track side collision mesh so players don't get stuck in the walls as easily.
[*] Update which should fix Windows erroneously reporting game as 'Not Responding' when loading
[/list]

notes.title: Level Editor Content Update
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work adding in some new content to the metric racer level editor. Here you can see one of the flyers zooming from track to terrain, to water and back onto the track.

One of the key features of Metric is that you aren't kept to just the track. There is full off-roading in this game, allowing you to explore the worlds created in the level editor.

[previewyoutube=yIqwLzHxuWE;full][/previewyoutube]
